coder_notes: mRNA vaccine trial (pp65 and personalised tumour RNA-LP) in recurrent paediatric HGG (ages 3-25) and osteosarcoma (3-39): excluded intervention type, no candidate. Glioblastoma WHO grade 4 is named in the pHGG inclusion criteria, and the trial also enrols osteosarcoma, so coded basket_gbm_eligible / basket true (alternatively mixed_glioma_gbm_named); the population is paediatric-focused. Levetiracetam is mentioned only as an example antiepileptic patients must be willing to take, not a registered intervention, so not listed. MMRD tumours are allowed, not required; not recorded as a biomarker.
